verdict.rationale: JumpCloud documents a broad REST API and PowerShell module for bulk operations across users, devices, and groups, directory event export, and Graph traversal, suggesting significant UI-equivalent coverage, plus GitHub example scripts. However there is no evidence of a comprehensive API-to-UI parity claim, and probes show no discoverable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt at expected endpoints, undermining confidence in full coverage. missing for 10: explicit parity statement covering all UI features (MFA config, conditional access policies, RADIUS, MDM settings) via API, working OpenAPI/spec discovery, independent verification of completeness.
